add.issue.comment.md:
Solution: fixed the skin-switch palette morph null crash found during the browser verification this ticket left open.

Symptom (Firefox wording): TypeError: can't access property "from", morph is null. Chromium: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'from'). Thrown once, on the frame that closes the 320ms crossfade — i.e. the first painter to repaint right after a skin click settles.

Cause: in web/field.js pal(), the morph branch stored closures on palCache that read the module-level `morph` (acc/dat/col => mix(morph.from.*, ...)), then set `morph = null` at the end of the same call before returning. palCache lives on past the window, so those closures dereferenced a cleared binding. Regression from this ticket's own 5d0c5ca (skin-switch crossfade and canvas palette morph).

Fix: snapshot the live morph into a local const and let the closures read that. Behaviour is unchanged — the final frame still resolves to the target skin's triple (mix returns t at k>=1), so the crossfade lands on the right colours and the cached palette stays valid through the following 60-frame TTL. Reduced-motion (duration 0) path untouched.

Location: branch BMRE3ZR-morph-null, commit d116a36, based on current origin/aether-live (includes PR #3 visual-polish; that PR only touched tokens.css, field.js byte-identical either side). Single file, +8/-4.

Verification (all on the rebased branch):
- node --check web/field.js: ok.
- Deterministic pal() harness with a stubbed DOM: throws "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'from')" on the pre-fix file, all steps pass on the fix.
- Headless Chromium (Playwright) on ?demo: clicked all seven skins with a pause longer than the morph window, plus a rapid 40ms burst, under both no-preference and reduced-motion — 0 console/page errors on the fix, 1 pageerror (the same null read) on the pre-fix copy.
- pytest collector: 115 passed, 3 skipped.

Not pushed and no PR opened yet; that is the owner's call. Branch is local only.

add.issue.comment.md:
Solution:

Landed two branches, both open against aether-live and left for the owner to merge.

https://github.com/T-Crypt/aether-grid/pull/5 (vanilla UI, findings 1-5)
- .toggles inherits flex-direction: column from .panel-body, which stretched every layer chip to 1494px wide. Pinned to a row; chips measure 144px.
- --p-dim failed 4.5:1 on four of seven skins (worst 3.93:1). Lightened aether, hexlab, isodose and corvane. Worst skin is now 4.55:1.
- Mobile chrome wrapped instead of scrolling; rail, pills and timecode together ate 403px of an 844px viewport and pushed the first panel to 49.5% of it. They now scroll sideways. The overrides sit at the end of tokens.css because the base .skin-rail rule re-declares flex-wrap: wrap at equal specificity and source order beat the @media. An earlier copy of these rules silently lost; that is the bug the prior probe missed. Rail is 108.8 -> 44.9px, first panel 49.5% -> 18.7%, all seven skin buttons still reachable by scroll.
- web/ named JetBrains Mono but shipped no @font-face, so every load fell through to generic monospace. Latin subset now self-hosted with the OFL license. Proven loaded by pixel comparison of rendered glyphs against the generic monospace, with a deliberately broken FontFace as the negative control. Width alone could not show it, because both advance 600/1000 units.
- Cohort well-id fills raised 0.55 -> 0.88/0.92 for the 4.5:1 floor. .br-id opacity 0.7 -> 0.92 and the panel hover border 0.28 -> 0.45, which was below the resting border and read as a weaker panel.

https://github.com/T-Crypt/aether-grid/pull/6 (React console)
- web-react/ adds a Vite + React 18 + Tailwind 3.4 console beside the untouched web/. A seeded 1 Hz simulator mirrors the speculum snapshot shape; no collector wiring yet. All seven skins, four field layers, three canvases, hoverable log. Verified across 1600/1280/768/390/375 with zero console errors, no horizontal overflow, canvases inked, dim contrast 9.87:1.
- dist/ is gitignored like node_modules/.

Verified this session: probe-vanilla.py (7 skins, mobile 390x844, zero console/page errors), verify-console.py on a fresh vite build (all checks pass), node --check on all three web JS files, and the collector suite at 115 passed / 3 skipped, matching the prior baseline.

Open product decision for the owner: docker/Dockerfile.web still copies only web/. Merging PR 6 does not switch the served UI; doing that means building web-react and copying dist/ into that image.

add.issue.comment.md:
Solution:

PR open against aether-live, left for the owner to merge: https://github.com/T-Crypt/aether-grid/pull/7

The React console is the app. One process is the whole stack: python3 collector/aether.py serves the built console from web-react/dist plus /api at :8792.

- Live feed wired: src/lib/adapt.js is the boundary (every collector field parsed defensively, NaN to null), reproducing the retired app.js semantics: snapshot rebuild, 1 Hz tick patch, request/event dedupe, session derivation, 2 s poll fallback when SSE cannot open, offline retry with an inline banner. src/lib/feed.js owns the EventSource lifecycle and closes it on stop.
- ?demo keeps the seeded simulator, unchanged, including prefers-reduced-motion starting it held. Pause/hold/step render in demo mode only, since there is nothing to step in live mode.
- Collector serves web-react/dist; main() exits 1 with the build instruction when dist is missing (import stays safe for the tests); .woff2 serves as font/woff2.
- Removed: web/ (the vanilla UI, 2,262 lines with it) and docker/ (Dockerfile.web, Dockerfile.collector, nginx.conf, compose.yml). The nginx image was a static file copier and the collector already serves static plus API from one handler, so the second container bought nothing. README, docs/DEPLOY.md and docs/VISUAL-MAP.md rebuilt around the single-process run.

Verified live at :8792 in a real browser: zero console errors, ticks advancing, host and GPU panels populated from this box, demo through the same collector, full verifier pass on the build (5 viewports, 7 skins, canvases inked, contrast 9.87:1, reduced motion), pytest 115 passed / 3 skipped.

add.issue.name: Scenes: prune, reword, and give each scene one telemetry charter

edit.description.md:
Second-opinion review of the scene work in PRs #15-#17, then a draft PR that acts on it.

Findings: scheme resolution exists twice (main.jsx and SceneRoot.switchScene); det/hashCode/pad/staleOf and the active-runtime resolver are duplicated across the four scene modules; dead exports tinStats/boxStats/cisternStats, useTarget, EVENT_TYPES; three unused imports; no lint or CI gate; --text-3 fails AA on the pan surface (3.59:1 safehouse, 3.69:1 hexlab); dock controls below 44px; the dock prints '7 schemes' on every scene.

Specialization: each scene declares the telemetry slice it owns and drops or demotes readouts that belong to another scene, so the five scenes read as five instruments instead of five dashboards.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: seven commits on feat/scene-charters-2026-10-16, draft PR #22 off aether-live. One derive module and one scheme resolver replace the copies. Each scene declares a charter in the registry and the dock prints it. Safehouse drops GPU temp from its header. Bloom-Line pulses on heat. Cyber-Pass tallies served tokens at a hundredth of a cent each with no label and no timer, and its device face drops temp and p95. Deepsignal leads with model, engine line and candidate count. The visual map names the five scenes. Build passes. Bundle moves from 400.55 kB to 399.75 kB. No unused imports or exports remain. The dim text tier clears AA with headroom on three scene pans.
